questions.q: What is the first stage of the accounting cycle described in this lesson?
options: Financial statements are prepared
A real-world business transaction occurs
The period is closed
A reversing entry is posted
questions.explain: The cycle begins with a real business event happening, before anything is recorded.

questions.q: What role does a trial balance play within the accounting cycle?
options: It is the very first step before any transaction occurs
It replaces the need for journal entries entirely
It only matters during foreign currency transactions
It verifies total debits equal total credits across the ledger, before financial statements are built
questions.explain: The trial balance is a checkpoint between posting (and adjusting) entries and preparing financial statements, confirming the ledger is in balance.

questions.q: In the Everhart Manufacturing example, why did the $15,000 transaction not require an adjusting entry?
options: The transaction was already fully recorded with a natural paper trail (the billed work), unlike accrued or deferred items with no invoice yet
Adjusting entries are never needed for any transaction
Because the client paid in cash immediately
Because the amount was below a $20,000 threshold
questions.explain: Adjusting entries exist for events with no natural paper trail (like unbilled accrued wages). This transaction was billed and fully recorded, so no adjustment was needed.

questions.q: Why does seeing the complete accounting cycle matter more than mastering any single stage in isolation?
options: Because only the final stage (financial statements) actually matters
Because the stages have no real connection to one another
Because when a reported number looks wrong, the cause could be at any link in the chain, and understanding the whole cycle helps narrow down where to look
Because Oracle Fusion only automates the first stage
questions.explain: A consultant troubleshooting a wrong number needs to understand the full chain, since an error anywhere along it can produce the same downstream symptom.

questions.q: How does this lesson describe the relationship between the accounting cycle and Oracle Fusion Financials?
options: There is no relationship; Oracle Fusion does not follow this cycle
Every stage of the cycle has a direct, named counterpart in Oracle Fusion: subledgers, Subledger Accounting, General Ledger, period close, and financial reporting
Oracle Fusion only automates the very last stage of the cycle
The accounting cycle only applies to paper-based bookkeeping
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Financials is built around this exact cycle, with each stage mapped to a specific module or process within the system.
